messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a concise overview of the key long‑weekends that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(For simplicity, I’ve focused on the federal holidays that create long weekends nationwide; provincial‑only holidays will differ by region.)

| Holiday | Calendar Date (2023) | Observed (if shifted) | Typical Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|----------------------|-----------------------|---------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 (observed) | **Dec 30–Jan 2** (Fri–Mon) |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, BC, Ontario, Saskatchewan)* | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 (observed) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Thursday Nov 11 | – | **Nov 10–12** (Wed–Fri) |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | **Dec 24–26** (Thu–Sat) |

### Quick Takeaway
- **Longest stretch:** Dec 30 – Jan 2 (New Year’s long weekend).
- **Most common pattern:** A holiday on a Monday or Friday gives a natural 3‑day break (e.g., Good Friday, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving).
- **Observed shifts:** Only New Year’s Day and Canada Day required an official “observed” day because they fell on a weekend.

Feel free to adjust the table for specific provinces if you’re targeting a particular region—just add their unique holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Heritage Day in British Columbia, etc.).
